description: List the follow-up reminders that are due: each a promise someone made the user in a meeting, who made it, the day to check back after, its status and its ID, oldest first (up to 20). Use it to see whose promises to chase; for meetings whose follow-up message hasn't gone out use list_followups_needed, and for follow-up meetings the user promised and never held use missed_followups.
name: list_follow_ups
